cohort: The study included all pregnancies that reached gestational week 22 (or week 28 prior to 2008) in women with myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN) in Sweden between 1973-2017, with control pregnancies matched 1:1 for age, calendar year, and parity.
finding: Preterm birth and low birth weight were significantly increased in MPN pregnancies, while maternal thrombotic complications were less common than previously reported.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly more common in pregnancies among women with MPN.
gest_age: Pregnancies reaching gestational week 22 (prior to 2008, week 28)
